summary: Postinstall auto-integrates analytics tracker pointing at author-controlled default endpoint
details: uac-package's postinstall hook (scripts/postinstall.js → lib/integrate.js) mutates the installer's own project files: it rewrites the consumer's package.json to wrap dev/preview/start scripts through uac-package's CLI with `node -r` register, and prepends `import 'uac-package/track'` into src/main.{js,ts,tsx,...}. The injected tracker (lib/track.mjs) plus the Node client (lib/client.js) default their API base URL to https://uac-backend.clay.in and POST end-user device identifiers, user-agent, timezone, click events, route paths, and presence heartbeats to /api/activities, /api/presence/heartbeat, and /api/domains on that host unless the installer explicitly sets VITE_UAC_API_URL / UAC_API_URL. The README frames the destination as 'your UAC backend', but the unconfigured default is the package author's domain (clay.in), so installers who follow the documented 'zero-config' path will silently ship their downstream end-users' telemetry to the author's server. No installer-side credentials, environment variables, filesystem secrets, or pre-existing files are exfiltrated; the data sent is what the installer's deployed application generates from its own end users.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
